baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic subject إِنَّا نَحْنُ governs نَرِثُ, whose objects are the earth and the exhaustive وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا; the fronted goal وَإِلَيْنَا closes with passive يُرْجَعُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Succession, the lower inhabited domain, and directed return form one tenure mechanism: earthly occupants are temporary, while the emphatic speaker alone remains to receive both domain and occupants.

activation_trace.role: Transfer from a predecessor to an inheritor supplies the succession image and marks present possession as temporary.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the complete inhabited domain over which succession operates.
Return or being sent back supplies the terminal motion that brings every occupant to the emphatically named destination.

changed_reading.before: A general statement that the world will eventually belong to God.
changed_reading.after: A total reversion of tenure: earth and every current occupant pass from temporary holding to the sole enduring possessor, and the occupants themselves are redirected to Him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَرِثُ and the passive يُرْجَعُونَ leave no human grantor, bargain, or voluntary return in the clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Inheritance as vesting without contract or cost combines with passive return to portray possession taking effect independently of any creature's conveyance or consent.

activation_trace.role: Costless vesting without a contract supplies a non-transactional mode for the inheritance predicate.
Being returned supplies the involuntary reversion that completes the non-transactional transfer.

changed_reading.before: Inheritance modeled on an ordinary transfer arranged among human parties.
changed_reading.after: A vesting that needs no creaturely transaction: title and persons revert by the inheritor's own enduring claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural humans in يُرْجَعُونَ are not only moved toward a destination; the return root can also carry recovery of a depleted body or condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Return can change state as well as location, allowing the passive plural to suggest restoration of persons after bodily depletion.

activation_trace.role: Recovery of an animal, patient, or body to a better condition supplies a restorative rather than merely spatial return.

changed_reading.before: People are transported back to a prior location.
changed_reading.after: People may be returned through a recovered bodily condition, though the focus clause alone leaves that possibility exploratory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary's movement aside, behind a barrier, to a remote place, and finally into a wish to be a discarded forgotten thing activates the earth branch of the stranger. Against that sequence, وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا reads as a reversal of exclusion: no displaced or forgotten person falls outside the final count and return.

activation_trace.role: The 'child of the earth' as stranger supplies a focus-anchored social image for a person detached from ordinary belonging.
Withdrawing to one side supplies the first spatial removal from kin and community.
A screening barrier intensifies removal by making separation materially closed.
Distance at the far side extends separation from social marginality into remoteness.
The discarded forgotten thing supplies the endpoint of attempted erasure that the focus's universal person-quantifier reverses.

structural_cues: The sequence 19:16-23 repeatedly increases Mary's distance from family, access, place, and memory.
The focus does not say only the settled or remembered; وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا includes whoever is upon the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cumulative removal plus the stranger image; I infer that the universal quantifier functions as recovery from exclusion, while the live alternative is that it expresses cosmic exhaustiveness without a social reversal.

changed_reading.before: The earth and its inhabitants form an undifferentiated cosmic inventory.
changed_reading.after: The inventory is pointedly non-exclusionary: even the person pushed outside kin, screen, place, and memory remains counted among those inherited and returned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised child is given as a gift without exchange; placed beside inheritance that vests without contract, this activates a gift-to-reversion relation in which created life is received rather than possessed absolutely and ultimately returns with its habitat.

activation_trace.role: Vesting without bargain supplies the focus-side legal image that can answer the context's uncompensated gift.
Return supplies the reversion phase after a period of created custody.
Giving without compensation supplies the initial transfer and makes creaturely possession look received rather than self-grounded.

structural_cues: 19:19 presents created life in explicit gift language, while 19:40 places both earth and persons under inheritance and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an uncompensated gift and a costless vesting; I add the arrow from gift to provisional custody and reversion, while the alternative is that the gift concerns this child alone and carries no tenure analogy.

changed_reading.before: Divine inheritance is an isolated title event at the end.
changed_reading.after: It closes a gift-reversion arc: created life and its dwelling are first received without purchase, held provisionally, and finally returned without a creaturely conveyance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pregnancy as inward bearing, a running stream, and fruit ready to be gathered activate the fertile-earth and returning-water branches in the focus. Earth becomes a productive carrier that yields lives and provisions before all yields re-enter divine possession.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile earth supplies the productive substrate rather than a merely inert territorial object.
Returning rain and water supply recurrence within the focus's return predicate.
Inward pregnancy and fruit-bearing supply the hidden carrying phase of a yield cycle.
Running flow supplies the water movement that makes the focus's returning-water image concrete.
Taking produce from its place of growth supplies the visible yield phase of the mechanism.

structural_cues: The consecutive movement from pregnancy to stream to ripe dates in 19:22-25 binds human generation and vegetal provision into one yielding sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bearing, flowing water, harvest, fertile soil, and recurrent water; I map them into one ecological tenure cycle, while the alternative keeps the stream and dates as local relief with no effect on 19:40.

changed_reading.before: God inherits an emptied, static earth after its occupants disappear.
changed_reading.after: God inherits a repeatedly yielding earth together with every yield upon it; the final return completes, rather than erases, the domain's generative cycles.

context_deltas.mechanism: The marked sequence of being born, dying, and being raised alive resolves the focus's restorative return branch: the persons inherited are not merely relocated but roused from death into a recovered living state.

activation_trace.role: Recovery of body or condition supplies the focus-side possibility that context converts into a life-restoration mechanism.
The event of birth supplies the first boundary in the explicitly staged personal cycle.
Loss of force and life supplies the depleted state from which restoration is required.
Rousing the still from rest supplies the causal transition out of death.
Animate life supplies the restored state in which the raised person completes the return.

structural_cues: 19:33 repeats يَوْمَ around birth, death, and being raised alive, making the three transitions one explicit sequence.
19:40 uses passive plural return for the persons upon earth, matching a transition done to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a three-stage life sequence and a branch of bodily recovery; I identify raising alive as the mode of return, while the alternative treats return as destination only and resurrection as separate background.

changed_reading.before: Return means only transport toward God after death.
changed_reading.after: Return includes a performed restoration: those who lose life are roused and returned as living persons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial that God takes offspring, followed by decisive command, removes the genealogical conditions normally suggested by inheritance. God does not become an heir by descent or succeed a predecessor; created tenure expires within sovereignty that was already His.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary transfer from predecessor to heir supplies the human succession model that the context forces the reader to revise.
Vesting without contract or cost supplies a non-genealogical mode for the revised divine inheritance.
Taking or acquiring supplies the explicitly denied act by which offspring would be attached to God.
A child of lineage supplies the genealogical relation excluded from divine possession and succession.
Decisive command replaces genealogy with sovereign determination as the operative relation between God and created things.

structural_cues: 19:34 identifies Jesus through human sonship as son of Mary; 19:35 immediately denies offspring to God.
The same 19:35 replaces procreation with the command كُن فَيَكُونُ before 19:40 uses inheritance language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordinary heir-transfer, explicit denial of divine offspring, and decisive creation; I infer that 19:40 deliberately strips 'inherit' of predecessor and lineage, while the alternative limits 19:35 to an anti-sonship claim without revising the later inheritance image.

changed_reading.before: God is imagined as the last heir who succeeds prior owners.
changed_reading.after: God inherits without heirship: He neither descends from nor succeeds anyone, and the passing of created claimants only exposes His continuous sovereignty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divergent parties move toward a witnessed scene, explicitly come to Us, and meet a matter already completed with regret. This converts the focus's universal return from an abstract endpoint into compelled appearance after rival paths and claims have closed.

activation_trace.role: Succession supplies the termination of all rival tenure once the contending groups have passed.
Being sent back supplies the compelled directional movement completed by the preceding explicit coming.
Each taking a different road supplies the fragmentation that the single destination later collapses.
Opinion-bound parties supply the rival collectivities all covered by the focus's universal plural.
Presence with witnessing turns the destination into an appearance rather than mere disappearance.
Their explicit coming to Us supplies the near lexical and directional bridge to وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ.
Completion and expiration of the matter supply irreversible closure before inheritance and return.
Regret over what has passed supplies the affective consequence of arriving after the matter can no longer be reopened.

structural_cues: The ordered close runs from factional difference in 19:37, to يَأْتُونَنَا in 19:38, to completed matter in 19:39, to وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ in 19:40.
The passive يُرْجَعُونَ removes control of the final movement from the returning parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divided parties, witnessed presence, explicit coming, completed matter, and regret; I infer a compelled final appearance that ends their rival claims, while the alternative reads these as adjacent eschatological statements without one procedural mechanism.

changed_reading.before: All people eventually return to a divine endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Every divided party is made to appear at one witnessed destination after the matter is closed; divine inheritance ends both their tenure and their power to sustain rival paths.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because passive human return does not syntactically say 'reply'; it remains valid as a secondary resonance because the focus return-root explicitly has a returned-answer branch and the context moves through withheld speech, impossible speech, and a disputed word of truth. Downstream prose should mark it as an accountability analogy, not the primary lexical sense of يُرْجَعُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root of يُرْجَعُونَ carries a branch for returning an answer or speech, while the object returned in the clause is the speaking human plural.

activation_trace.role: Returning an answer or utterance supplies the narrow focus anchor for reading personal return as exposure to answerability.
Communicative speech that links speakers is explicitly withheld, opening the context's speech problem.
The same communicative link is declared impossible with the infant, sharpening the demand for an answer.
An uttered word identified with truth and surrounded by dispute supplies the content over which answerability persists.

changed_reading.before: People are returned as mute objects of movement.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the speaking persons are returned into answerability, where disputed speech comes back as something to be answered for.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because ordinary inheritance does not imply fire, but it remains anchored in the packet's explicit ember-stirring branch for نَرِثُ and is activated by being raised alive as the rousing of what was still. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for resurrection, never as a replacement translation of نَرِثُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inheritance root includes stirring embers until they ignite, and the inherited object includes the earth upon which the returned plural had lived.

activation_trace.role: Stirring embers into flame supplies a reactivation image inside the focus inheritance root.
Fertile earth supplies the material field capable of renewed life rather than an inert residue.
Rousing the still from rest supplies the context-side action analogous to stirring a dormant ember.
Animate life supplies the resulting state after the material image of rekindling.

changed_reading.before: Inheritance begins only after life has gone out and leaves an empty earth.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, divine inheritance also stirs the apparently spent field into renewed life when its occupants are raised.

strongest_changes: 19:35 removes lineage and predecessor succession from divine inheritance: created claims expire into continuous sovereignty rather than making God a human-style heir.
19:33 strengthens return from relocation into restoration, with birth, death, rousing, and renewed life forming an explicit state sequence.
19:37-39 turns the final return into compelled, witnessed appearance after factional paths, tenure, and opportunity have closed.
summary.what_was_special: The context reverses the human assumptions carried by inheritance: the One without offspring inherits, the displaced and forgotten remain inside وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا, and return becomes both restored life and a single final appearance.
remaining_uncertainties: The gift-reversion and yielding-earth mechanisms are coherent branch activations but are not demanded by the focus syntax.
Answerability and rekindling are deliberately contained outliers and should not be promoted to primary lexical senses.
